name: craft
description: Standalone agent runtime, capability discovery, durable tasks, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, and reusable workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, orchestrate, evaluate, and reuse capabilities.
interface.longDescription: Craft provides a preview standalone agent runtime, indexes user-selected capabilities, and manages durable task state, host-mediated multi-agent plans, evidence, evaluations, and reusable workflows under ~/.craft_data.
defaultPrompt: Use Craft to continue a saved task.
Find relevant capabilities for this task.
Save this correction as a reusable workflow candidate.
Coordinate this task across suitable agent profiles and verify the result.
